Headline: #70 Division Temporary Reroute at Division/Cicero
ShortDescription: 70 Division buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near Division/Cicero.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#70 Division buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Division, Cicero, Augusta, Kostner, Division and over regular route due to street blockage near Division/Cicero.

Allow extra travel time.
